lines.say: The average Polish worker works about 1,807 hours a year.
That's 472 hours more. About twelve extra forty-hour weeks, every year.
Poland has caught up fast. Its GDP per person is now three quarters of Germany's.
But per hour worked, a Polish worker produces about 47 dollars of output. A German worker, about 82.
Per hour, Poland is at 57 percent of Germany. The long hours are doing a lot of the work.
How Poland caught up is in our full video.
